fields.description: Époque brings a smaller collection of one- and two-bedroom apartments to Meydan Horizon, with a lagoon-facing setting and shared leisure spaces.

sources.label: Époque and Verso: developer launch, 2 October 2026

overview: A compact release within Reportage’s wider Meydan Horizon launch.
research.locationNote: The developer places Époque in Meydan Horizon. Property Finder groups it under the broader Ras Al Khor area.
research.priceNote: Property Finder gives an AED 1.9 million launch guide; EZRE quotes AED 1,884,097. No dated primary price list or live selected-home quotation was verified.
research.paymentNote: The table is Property Finder’s reference: 20% during construction and 80% at handover. EZRE instead labels the first 20% as booking and also lists 30 / 70 alternatives. No original dated schedule was verified; confirm booking, instalments and discount conditions.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder and EZRE target Q4 2029, with Property Finder specifying December. The reviewed developer page and originals provide no contractual completion date; this remains a secondary forecast.
